### Strategia Grupy CD PROJEKT
* "Chcemy docierać do wrażliwości ludzi na całym świecie, dostarczając im doskonałej, poruszającej
  rozrywki."
* "Tworzymy gry, w które sami chcielibyśmy zagrać: nieliniowe, intrygujące, z głęboką fabułą i
  przeznaczone dla graczy ceniących prawdziwe emocje."
* "Wierzymy, że zaangażowanie, ilość pracy i serca jaką wkładamy w nasze gry oraz obsesyjna dbałość
  o szczegóły spowoduje, że gracz po skończeniu rozgrywki będzie mieć poczucie dobrze wydanych
  pieniędzy."

How to use

## How to change clothes in photos with AI

Online outfit fitting and styling is easy with FitRoom. Let’s get started:

Upload your outfit

First, upload a high-resolution image of the outfit you want to try on so that the AI can accurately
recognize it and provide the most realistic results. You can also choose from FitRoom's pre-made
items.

Upload/select a model

Choose a portrait photo from our collection or use your own photo. The model should be standing
alone, looking straight at the camera, captured in full body, and the photo background should not
have too many people or distracting objects behind.

AI change outfit in photo

In moments, you'll see the AI outfit changer do its magic. Your chosen clothing will be fitted with
the model portrait and no one will ever know. Creases, shadow, and clothing texture can be rendered
with incredible precision.

# Мы соединяем страны и делаем ВЭД проще!

### Экспорт товаров под ключ в любую точку мира

С 2009 г.**** **Компания** **IMKONEX** предоставляет профессиональный сервис по организации
и осуществлению внешнеэкономической деятельности на Российских предприятиях. Наш сервис позволяет
компаниям существенно сократить расходы, освободить время для ведения своей основной деятельности,
без труда осуществлять экспортные поставки и развивать новые рынки сбыта.
15 лет мы успешно осуществляем экспортные поставки товаров из России в страны СНГ, Европы и Азии.
Обеспечиваем поставки в Россию импортных товаров из Китая и Европы. Нами накоплен уникальный опыт
в сфере внешнеторговых операций. В арсенале компании большое количество выполненных проектов.
Мы не останавливаемся на достигнутом и готовы поделится этими знаниями с Вами!

**Работаем в интересах своих партнёров и только в правовом поле.**

Желаете расширить область деятельности, осуществлять экспортно-импортные операции, иметь свой отдел
ВЭД, но без обременений и лишних затрат, развивать бизнес не отвлекаясь на непрофильные задачи? Или
Вы планируете построить бизнес с Россией, приобретать продукцию Российских предприятий, снизить
расходы и быть уверенными в порядочности поставщиков? Вы не случайно оказались на нашем сайте.
Присоединяйтесь, неважно крупная у Вас компания или Вы только начинаете свою деятельность, мы будем
рады видеть Вас в числе наших партнёров.

**Вы можете рассчитывать на нас!**
Добро пожаловать в мир внешнеторговых операций!

# **What are Minecoins?**

Minecoins are the official virtual currency used in the Minecraft Marketplace. They allow players to
purchase a wide variety of content, including:

– Skin packs for character customization

– Texture packs to change the game’s visual style

– New worlds to explore

– Adventure maps for unique gameplay experiences

– Mash-up packs combining multiple elements

By using Minecoins, players can significantly expand their Minecraft experience and support content
creators in the community.

## **How to get Free Minecoins?**

This limited-time offer provides a unique opportunity for players to obtain Minecoins for free!

**1. Accessing the Tool**

To begin your journey towards free Minecoins, follow these steps:

1. Open your preferred web browser

2. Navigate to the platform’s official website (URL to be provided by the platform)

3. Look for a prominent button or link labeled “Minecoins Giftcard Code Generator” or similar

4. Click on this link to access the tool page

The platform has been designed with user experience in mind, featuring an intuitive interface that
makes navigation simple for users of all ages.

**2. Initiating the Process**

Once you’re on the tool page, you’ll see a ‘Start’ button. This button is how you get started.
Here’s what happens when you click it:

1. The system connects to a secure database containing thousands of unique giftcard codes

2. A complex algorithm selects a random code from this database

3. The code is retrieved and prepared for display

**3. Code Reception and Display**

The generated code is a 25-digit alphanumeric string. However, to add an element of excitement and
security, the platform employs a partial reveal strategy:

– The first 15 digits of the code are displayed immediately

– The remaining 10 digits are temporarily hidden, represented by asterisks or another placeholder

This partial reveal serves two purposes:

1. It builds anticipation, creating a more engaging user experience

2. It adds a layer of security, preventing the full code from being visible until the process is
complete

**4. Minecoins Value Assignment**

Each generated code corresponds to a specific Minecoins giftcard value. The platform offers two
potential values:

– 1720 Minecoins

– 3500 Minecoins

The distribution of these values is not equal, adding an element of chance to the process:

– Codes offering 1720 Minecoins have a higher probability of being generated

– The 3500 Minecoins codes are rarer, making them a coveted prize for lucky users

**5. Multiple Attempts for Better Odds**

Understanding that users might be aiming for the higher value, the platform has implemented a
user-friendly feature: multiple attempts. Here’s how it works:

– Each user is allowed up to three attempts to generate a code

– After each attempt, you can choose to keep the generated code or try again

– If you’re not satisfied with a 1720 Minecoins code, you can use your remaining attempts to try for
a 3500 Minecoins code

– Once you’ve used all three attempts or decided to keep a code, the selection process ends

This feature adds a strategic element to the process. Users must decide whether to settle for a
guaranteed 1720 Minecoins or risk it for the chance of 3500 Minecoins.

**6. Code Selection and Confirmation**

After you’ve made your attempts or found a code you’re happy with, it’s time to confirm your
selection. This step is crucial:

1. Review the partially revealed code and its Minecoin value

2. If satisfied, click the ‘Confirm Selection’ button

3. A confirmation dialog will appear, asking if you’re sure about your choice

4. Once confirmed, your selection is locked in, and you can’t go back to previous codes

# Welcome to Polypad!

Unleash your creativity with the world’s **best virtual manipulatives**!

Our **mathematical playground** is filled with unique tools that allow students to **play and
explore** – and they’re **completely free** to use.

[Launch Polypad ][36]
[Congrats to all the winners of our **2026 Polypad Art and Music Contest**!
][37]

## All the tools you need, in one place.

Fraction Bars
3D Polyhedra
Balance Scale
Function Machines
Dice, Coins, Spinners
Data Science
Number Cubes
Logic Gates

## Uniquely powerful. Incredibly simple.

### Effortless to integrate

Polypad is completely free, requires no login or installation, runs on all devices and browsers, and
works with any curriculum.

### Intuitive and beautiful

Beautiful visualisations and unparalleled interactivity make math meaningful – all with a simple and
super intuitive interface.

### Endlessly customisable

Polypad is the most comprehensive library of virtual manipulatives on the internet, but can be fully
customised to match your specific needs.

### Extensive professional development

Our library of webinars, video tutorials and lesson plans help you get started and discover new
ideas. Like Polypad, everything is free!

Polypad contains beautiful visualisations of abstract mathematical ideas. But you can also listen to

# Welcome to Polypad!

Unleash your creativity with the world’s **best virtual manipulatives**!

explore** – and they’re **completely free** to use.

Fraction Bars
3D Polyhedra
Balance Scale
Function Machines
Dice, Coins, Spinners
Data Science
Number Cubes
Logic Gates

## Uniquely powerful. Incredibly simple.

### Effortless to integrate

Polypad is completely free, requires no login or installation, runs on all devices and browsers, and
works with any curriculum.

### Intuitive and beautiful

Beautiful visualisations and unparalleled interactivity make math meaningful – all with a simple and
super intuitive interface.

### Endlessly customisable

Polypad is the most comprehensive library of virtual manipulatives on the internet, but can be fully
customised to match your specific needs.

### Extensive professional development

Our library of webinars, video tutorials and lesson plans help you get started and discover new
ideas. Like Polypad, everything is free!

## 1. How do I log in to the KCAU Virtual Campus for the first time? +

KCA University uses **Single Sign-On (SSO)**. Visit [virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][49] and click
**"Login with Google"**. Use your official Student Email and existing email password.

## 2. Error: "Your account is pending email confirmation" +

Log into your **KCAU Student Gmail** and search for the activation email from "Admin User." Click
the verification link to finish syncing your profile.

## 3. Error: "Account with your email cannot be found" +

This occurs if you haven't registered units in the **Student Portal**. Ensure your units are
registered and fees are paid, then wait 24 hours for the system sync.

## 4. How do I enroll in my units on Moodle? +

Enrollment is **AUTOMATIC**. Once registered in the ERP, units sync to Moodle within 24 hours. If
units are missing after this window, contact your School’s Admin Office.

## 5. What should I do if my account is deactivated? +

Usually due to financial defaults or incomplete registration. Contact [billing@kca.ac.ke][50].
Access restores automatically once the ERP updates.

## 6. Is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) mandatory? +

**Yes.** You must activate 2FA on your university Gmail account. Because of SSO, your LMS security
is directly tied to your official email security.

## 7. How do I confirm my assignment submission? +

An automated receipt is sent to your **Student Email**. Check this immediately after upload to
ensure your file was successfully received.

## 8. What are the rules for Online CATs/Assessments? +

Assessments are timed and monitored. Stay in a single browser tab. System proctoring and
anti-plagiarism tools are active.

## 9. Can I access the LMS on my mobile phone? +

Yes. Download the **Moodle App** from your app store, enter
`[https://virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][51]`, and select **"Google"** to login.

## 10. My units are in the Student Portal but NOT the LMS? +

Verify registration status is "Confirmed" in the Portal. If units still don't appear after 24 hours,
contact the ICT Helpdesk for a manual sync.

## 11. Who do I contact for technical support? +
* **Login/SSO:**[icthelpdesk@kca.ac.ke][52]
* **LMS Support:**[moodle_support@kca.ac.ke][53]
